blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation — what we are learning running governed agent fleets in production.

Agents fail for organizational reasons before they fail for technical ones: unclear autonomy tiers, missing envelopes, no credit assignment. The theses below come from fleets we operate, not from a demo script.
Read the position that matches the decision on your desk this quarter — then bring your counter-case; the briefing exists for exactly that argument.
